name: Arborborn
description:
Arborborn is awakened nature-magic learned from rare druidic tomes. Levels 1-20 grant primal plant, physical and toxic abilities. True advancement requires abandoning your race: at level 20 you can craft a Heartwood Altar and perform the Arborborn Ritual with sap, permanently replacing your racial identity. Transformations are available only after the change.

Every level from 11 onward grants +1 statistic.

Level 30 grants Arborborn Mastery (+10% all attributes; stacks with other combat-branch masteries).
